description: Independent organic search analytics: clicks, impressions, top pages and queries, traffic changes, keyword opportunities, and indexing or crawl evidence from connected accounts.

interface.longDescription: IndexGlow is an independent search analytics service developed by Max Bryselbout. Understand your site's organic search traffic and visibility using your own connected Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools accounts. See which pages and queries bring clicks, compare periods, investigate traffic changes, and prioritize keyword, click-through rate and cannibalization opportunities. Explore an interactive dashboard and review recorded indexing or crawl evidence. Each search engine's results remain separate, and recommendations use the properties you authorize. Search clicks measure organic search activity rather than total website visits or conversions. IndexGlow does not crawl entire websites, access competitors' private data, manage paid ads, or guarantee rankings or indexing. Sitemap submission, resubmission or removal and Bing URL submissions require an explicit request and the corresponding account permission. Submissions may trigger processing that cannot be undone. IndexGlow is not affiliated with or endorsed by the connected search providers or assistant platforms.
capabilities: Google and Bing search traffic and visibility
Top pages, search queries and performance trends
Organic traffic drop and growth investigation
Google indexing and Bing crawl diagnosis
Sitemap management and Bing URL submission
defaultPrompt: Show my Google and Bing search performance for the last 28 days.
Why did my organic search clicks fall last month?
Check whether a page on my site is indexed by Google and has been crawled by Bing.

prompts: Show my Google and Bing search performance for the last 28 days.
Why did my organic search clicks fall last month?
Check whether a page on my site is indexed by Google and has been crawled by Bing.

positive.description: Display Google and Bing search performance for the demo-outdoor.example sample property.
positive.prompt: Show an interactive dashboard comparing Google and Bing search performance for demo-outdoor.example over the last 28 days.
positive.tools_triggered: show_search_dashboard; list_search_sites only if property discovery is needed.
positive.expected_behavior: IndexGlow calls show_search_dashboard once for demo-outdoor.example over 28 days and renders one interactive dashboard with separate Google and Bing figures. It does not also call get_search_overview or get_performance_overview for the same summary. A brief confirmation is enough. The account’s data is synthetic.

positive.description: Compare two equal 28-day periods for demo-outdoor.example and identify the largest contributors.
positive.prompt: How did organic search clicks for demo-outdoor.example change in the last 28 days versus the previous 28 days, and which pages and queries contributed?
positive.tools_triggered: get_performance_overview, compare_periods; list_sites or list_search_sites only if property discovery is needed.
positive.expected_behavior: IndexGlow compares the two 28-day windows for demo-outdoor.example and identifies page and query contributors from the returned data, without asserting an unsupported cause.

positive.description: Prioritize keyword and CTR opportunities for demo-outdoor.example.
positive.prompt: Which pages and queries on demo-outdoor.example could win more organic clicks?
positive.tools_triggered: get_performance_overview, find_keyword_opportunities; list_sites or list_search_sites only if property discovery is needed.
positive.expected_behavior: IndexGlow reports prioritized opportunities for demo-outdoor.example grounded in impressions, clicks, CTR, and available position, keeping Google and Bing evidence separate.

positive.description: Inspect a known URL in the demo Google Search Console property.
positive.tools_triggered: inspect_url; list_sites only if property discovery is needed.
positive.expected_behavior: IndexGlow calls inspect_url for this exact URL in sc-domain:demo-outdoor.example and reports Google’s recorded verdict and coverage, including crawl and canonical evidence. The demo fixture is submitted and indexed; this is not a live crawl.

positive.description: Find overlapping queries across pages of demo-outdoor.example.
positive.prompt: Are several pages on demo-outdoor.example competing for the same search queries?
positive.tools_triggered: find_cannibalization; list_sites or list_search_sites only if property discovery is needed.
positive.expected_behavior: IndexGlow calls find_cannibalization for demo-outdoor.example and returns candidate page pairs with supporting metrics, without treating query overlap alone as proof of a problem.

negative.description: Do not invoke IndexGlow because it analyzes organic search data and does not create or manage paid advertising campaigns.
negative.prompt: Create and optimize a Google Ads campaign for my new product.

negative.description: Do not invoke IndexGlow as a full-site crawler. Explain that IndexGlow can inspect connected search and indexing data, but it does not crawl an entire website.
negative.prompt: Crawl my entire website and audit every technical SEO issue.

negative.description: Do not invoke a write tool. Explain that IndexGlow can inspect Google indexing but URL submission is available only for Bing.
negative.prompt: Submit https://example.com/new-page to Google for indexing.

publication.release_notes: IndexGlow 0.4.8 clarifies its independent publisher and uses a neutral organic-search listing. Sitemap submissions and Bing URL submissions are now marked as potentially irreversible, alongside sitemap removal. All 15 tools have explicit boolean annotations and behavior-specific review justifications. Existing search analytics, dashboards and six skills are retained.
